_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular manifest fragment — never edit src/manifest.json
_meta.description: Slice 05 of the bookkeeping-purchase-order-3way chain wires the rich SupplierInvoiceDetail Vue view onto the SupplierInvoiceDetail manifest page. The plain generated detail page lives in slice 01's fragment; this fragment overlays a kind=page custom component that adds the OCR-confidence indicator, Peppol/UBL provenance block and the related ThreeWayMatch placeholder. Registered as kind=page custom component in src/registry.js.
